title: Kamishiro Rui — Passionate Prop Making〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright. It's getting late, so why don't we call it an evening?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, dear. Just look at the time. I didn't realize at all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you're right! I need to get home and get ready for bed...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I was gonna talk with my brothers ahead of our meeting tomorrow, too! I've gotta hurry home!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood. We've all worked ourselves to the bone, so be sure to rest up properly.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Have a good evening, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good night, Tsukasa. See you at school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Rest well tonight, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why aren't you going home?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well now, this has gotten awkward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had intended to revise the script before I went home for the night. I'd like to incorporate some of our ad-libs from today before I forget them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you intend to do, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I plan to go over some lines alone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I noticed some points during rehearsal that I'd like to dig into. I want to get them solid before tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. It makes sense you'd want to do that while it's still fresh. I suppose we'll both be working on our own projects, then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sure. Though I have to say... We've certainly grown used to gathering here in the evenings, haven't we?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even though we said we'd leave our evenings free for solo practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's just become our habit, it seems. Ever since that day you all came together to check on me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You really helped me that day. I hope you know I'm grateful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's true what they say. Dependable friends are all you need.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your thoughts and feedback have gone a long way toward helping me surmount the wall ahead of me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. When the contest is over, I have half a mind to do something to pay you all back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'd love some fancy barbeque. Thanks in advance, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey! No one said anything about treating you to dinner!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still... If we're discussing payback, then I feel as though I owe you all, myself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I am terribly grateful to you all for being my friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Every time each of you takes a step forward, I feel the drive to advance even further.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When you grow closer to your dreams, it brings me closer to my own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And... The closer I get to my own dream, the closer I can bring you all to yours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of us are connected, pulling each other forward. That's how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, all the more reason for us to win this contest, and bring all of us another step forward!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll make this a true leap forward, toward our dreams.
